glossary.name: Checkout Service
glossary.meaning: the part of the website where a shopper places an order

glossary.name: Payment Gateway
glossary.meaning: the connection that asks the bank to accept a payment

glossary.name: Reporting Service
glossary.meaning: the tool that adds up sales for store managers

glossary.name: Customer Messages
glossary.meaning: the tool that sends order and delivery messages

glossary.name: Delivery Board
glossary.meaning: the screen staff use to see where deliveries are

glossary.name: Route Planner
glossary.meaning: the tool that chooses a delivery route

glossary.name: Refund Service
glossary.meaning: the tool that returns money after an approved cancellation

glossary.name: Stock Counter
glossary.meaning: the counter that tracks how many items are available

glossary.name: Product Catalog
glossary.meaning: the list of products, prices and product details

glossary.name: Rewards Wallet
glossary.meaning: the balance of a shopper’s reward points

glossary.name: Seller Portal
glossary.meaning: the workspace used by partner stores

glossary.name: Help Desk
glossary.meaning: the workspace used to help shoppers

glossary.name: Subscription Billing
glossary.meaning: the tool that charges repeat grocery subscriptions

glossary.name: Warehouse Updates
glossary.meaning: the feed that reports packing and stock movements

glossary.meaning: the tool that reserves a collection time at a store
